Full index — German State AI Evidence Layers

items.docs:
State dossiers assembled from three separate evidence layers: infrastructure, public systems and procurement signals.

Attribution: i6eal state dossiers assembled from BNetzA, MaKI and official procurement data.

Reuse: The three evidence layers have separate rights: broadband data identifies DL-DE/BY-2.0, procurement sources have their own terms, and MaKI redistribution has not been verified.
